description.value: A single-location Nanaimo pizza and pasta restaurant in business since 1997, situated on Metral Drive in the north end of the city. The kitchen describes itself as doing 'more than just Pizza & Pasta' and offers citywide delivery alongside in-store pickup. A reliable sit-down or takeout option for touring cyclists passing through Nanaimo's north side.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operating business at 4-6404 Metral Dr, Nanaimo, with current hours and online ordering. A phone discrepancy exists: OSM's primary phone tag is +1 250 390 2888, but the website and OSM's mobile tag both show (778) 268-3663; the website value is used. The website also uses a substantially different business name ('Little George's Local Guys Food (B.I.G) since 1997') versus the OSM name ('Little George's Pizza & Pasta'). No cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned on the website beyond confirmed pickup/delivery ordering.
